* Helper for accessing features in ListPopupWindow introduced after API level 4
 * in a backwards compatible fashion.

variables.name: IMPL
variables.comment: * Select the correct implementation to use for the current platform.

methods.name: public static OnTouchListener createDragToOpenListener(Object listPopupWindow, View src)
methods.comment:
* On API {@link android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES#KITKAT} and higher, returns * an {@link OnTouchListener} that can be added to the source view to * implement drag-to-open behavior. Generally, the source view should be the * same view that was passed to ListPopupWindow.setAnchorView(View). *

* When the listener is set on a view, touching that view and dragging * outside of its bounds will open the popup window. Lifting will select the * currently touched list item. *

* Example usage: * * 

     * ListPopupWindow myPopup = new ListPopupWindow(context);
     * myPopup.setAnchor(myAnchor);
     * OnTouchListener dragListener = myPopup.createDragToOpenListener(myAnchor);
     * myAnchor.setOnTouchListener(dragListener);
     *
* * @param listPopupWindow the ListPopupWindow against which to invoke the * method * @param src the view on which the resulting listener will be set * @return a touch listener that controls drag-to-open behavior, or null on * unsupported APIs

methodNames: public static OnTouchListener createDragToOpenListener(Object listPopupWindow, View src)
